size.value: Two colour photographs, not larger than 45 x 35mm nor smaller than 32 x 26mm

validity.value: Photographs must be taken within the last 3 months

expression_restriction.value: Neutral expression; no smiling, open mouth, or frowning

glasses_policy.value: No glasses at the point of the photograph being taken

headwear_policy.value: No headpiece or hair covering, except for religious purposes and only if the full facial features are clearly visible, including the ears

accessories.value: Studs/earrings are not accepted on male applicants' pictures

clothing_restriction.value: No white tops, since the background is white and a white top would not contrast; shoulders must be covered

face_visibility.value: Eyes, ears, and full facial features must be clearly visible for identification and facial recognition

ears_visibility.value: Ears must be clearly visible, as part of the full facial features required for identification and facial recognition

clothing.en: No white tops, since the background is white and a white top would not contrast; shoulders must be covered.
clothing.ko: 흰색 상의 착용 불가(배경이 흰색이라 대비가 되지 않음). 어깨는 가려야 함.
clothing.ja: 白いトップスの着用不可(背景が白のためコントラストが出ない)。肩は隠すこと。

expression.en: Neutral expression; no smiling, open mouth, or frowning.
expression.ko: 무표정 유지. 미소, 입 벌림, 찡그림 금지.
expression.ja: 無表情であること。笑顔、口を開けること、しかめ面は禁止。

glasses.en: No glasses at the point of the photograph being taken.
glasses.ja: 撮影時に眼鏡の着用は不可。

ears.en: Eyes, ears, and full facial features must be clearly visible for identification and facial recognition.
ears.ko: 눈, 귀, 얼굴의 모든 특징이 신원 확인 및 안면 인식을 위해 또렷하게 보여야 함.
ears.ja: 目、耳、顔のすべての特徴が本人確認・顔認証のためにはっきりと見える必要がある。

face_visibility.en: Eyes, ears, and full facial features must be clearly visible for identification and facial recognition.
face_visibility.ko: 눈, 귀, 얼굴의 모든 특징이 신원 확인 및 안면 인식을 위해 또렷하게 보여야 함.
face_visibility.ja: 目、耳、顔のすべての特徴が本人確認・顔認証のためにはっきりと見える必要がある。

headwear.en: No headpiece or hair covering, except for religious purposes and only if the full facial features are clearly visible, including the ears.
headwear.ko: 머리 장식이나 머리가리개는 착용 불가(종교적 목적 예외, 이 경우에도 귀를 포함한 얼굴 전체 특징이 또렷하게 보여야 함).
headwear.ja: 頭部の装飾品や被り物の着用は不可(宗教上の目的の場合を除く。その場合も耳を含む顔全体の特徴がはっきりと見える必要がある)。

accessories.en: Studs/earrings are not accepted on male applicants' pictures.
accessories.ko: 남성 신청자의 경우 스터드/귀걸이 착용 불가.
accessories.ja: 男性申請者の写真ではスタッド/イヤリングの着用は認められない。

cross_verification.note: Direct WebFetch of every guyanahctrinidad.mission.gov.gy, pp.gpf.gov.gy, and other mission.gov.gy subdomain page attempted returned HTTP 403 (Cloudflare-style bot protection applied site-wide). The values recorded as verified above appeared consistently and with matching specific wording (dimensions, 3-month age limit, 'studs/earrings not accepted on male applicants', 'no white tops') across five independently issued WebSearch queries, all explicitly attributing them to guyanahctrinidad.mission.gov.gy ('Passports – Consulate General of Guyana') and/or pp.gpf.gov.gy (the Guyana Police Force's official online passport-appointment portal, launched 2026). Size (45x35mm max / 32x26mm min) is consistent with the DB's 3.5x4.5cm figure sitting at the maximum end of that official range, so no conflict was filed.
